Chapter 860: Chapter 7: The Twelve Great Cosmic Powers (Please Subscribe)

“Galaxy Master?”

“Do we all follow the orders of the Galaxy Master?”

Several Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers exchanged glances.

The strongest among these evolvers showed a look of surprise.

Whether in the Human Civilization Alliance or among the Starry Sky Races, power dictates rank.

To have these Eleventh Level Evolvers… all obeying the Galaxy Master,

The most fundamental premise—

is that the Galaxy Master himself cannot be weak.

“Yes.”

“Obey the command of the supreme.”

The Evolvers immediately nodded in response.

Even though Xia Qin’s command puzzled all Eleventh Level Evolvers,

there must be a reason since the supreme said so; this newly promoted Eleventh Level Galaxy Master’s strength must far exceed everyone’s imagination.

“Galaxy Master?” Nalan, the vice tower lord, blinked, looking with a slightly unfamiliar expression at Lin Yuan sitting beside him.

To think that the Galaxy Master he has watched from Level Six or Seven, now commanded such attention from Xia Qin, and ruled over all Eleventh Level of Xia You Evolution Tower?

Such a status, placed in Xia You Evolution Tower, is second only to the supreme; even within the Human Civilization Alliance, it would securely rank in the top twenty.

There are nine Evolution Towers within human civilization, each with a vice lord.

But vice lords, typically at Level Ten, handle trivial matters and have no authority to command Eleventh Level Evolvers.

“Let’s go.”

Xia Qin swept his gaze over everyone, and space-time began to shift.

Moments later,

Xia Qin, along with all the Evolvers, arrived at the edge of a Vast Continent.

This Vast Continent, containing extreme spatial-temporal suppression, spans over a thousand light-years in diameter, like a colossal entity stretching out under the cosmic skies.

“Is that the super-large battlefield?”

“The spatial-temporal suppression is terrifying; I can feel that spatial shifting there will be greatly restricted.”

“No wonder it’s the ultimate rule battlefield jointly constructed by several supremes.”

The Eleventh Level Evolvers of Xia You Evolution Tower couldn’t help but whisper amongst themselves.

Previously, Eleventh Level Evolvers rarely had a chance to act even in large battlefields, and now in the super-large Battlefield of Different Races, being Eleventh Level is just the threshold?

“The Spatial-Temporal Maze…”

Compared to other Eleventh Level Evolvers, the super-large battlefield looked to Lin Yuan like an unprecedented Spatial-Temporal Maze,

The Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule operated, rendering the battlefield in an incredibly stable state.

“Truly marvelous…” admired Lin Yuan inwardly, though his comprehension of spacetime also reached the Sixth Realm, he was far from being able to create such an immense Spatial-Temporal Maze.

This required an immense foundation; even combined efforts of peak forces’ supreme beings took almost half a year to complete.

In reality, the creation of this super-large battlefield took more than just half a year; long ago, major forces had plans to develop such a battlefield.

Since then, they’ve been preparing for this.

Swish swish swish.

Xia Qin, along with many Eleventh Level Evolvers, appeared, and soon dozens of distinctly different presences approached.

“Greetings to Supreme Xia Qin.”

These dozens of presences, profound and spanning a depth, were Eleventh Level beings, not human evolvers, but those from different races serving under human civilization and independent Eleventh Level entities from Starry Sky races, and so on.

As a peak race, human civilization, sprawling across the Cosmic Starry Skies, naturally attracts a large number of strong beings; hence human civilization is also known as the Human Civilization Alliance.

“Upon entering the battlefield, everyone follows the orders of the Galaxy Master.”

Xia Qin, with a calm tone, gave a casual command.

“Yes.”

Dozens of Eleventh Level from different races were inwardly startled; they had of course heard of the renown of the Galaxy Master, but they didn’t expect Xia Qin to entrust him with such a heavy responsibility?

And it seemed, not only those different Eleventh Level races but all Evolvers of Eleventh Level from Xia You Evolution Tower were to obey the Galaxy Master.

Could Xia Qin be overly favoring this newly promoted Eleventh Level?

Many Eleventh Level different races evolvers were wavering in thought, but they didn’t dare to defy the command of the supreme.

“Fifty-two Eleventh Level from different races in total.”

Lin Yuan glanced at them and took note.

Originally, Xia You Evolution Tower’s Eleventh Level Evolvers numbered one hundred forty-three; including these fifty-two from different races, the total count of Eleventh Level strong beings affiliated with Xia You Evolution Tower nears two hundred.

Lin Yuan looked up and saw the other eight Evolution Towers of human civilization nearby.

The nine Evolution Towers of human civilization had similar strength; Xia You Evolution Tower gathered nearly two hundred Eleventh Level strong beings, so the other eight towers were probably of similar count.

All Eleventh Level strong beings from the nine Evolution Towers together would likely reach one thousand eight hundred?

Human civilization has openly less than a thousand Eleventh Level Evolvers; now, with these one thousand eight hundred, almost half are from different races.

Some are Eleventh Levels secretly fostered by human civilization.

…

“One thousand eight hundred Eleventh Levels…” Lin Yuan gazed further into the distance.

Just from the human civilization side, the deployment reached this number; then, combining all Eleventh Levels from all peak forces, wouldn’t there be tens of thousands?

Tens of thousands of Eleventh Levels?

This probably occupies a significant proportion of all Eleventh Level beings across the entire universe.

For the dominance of this super-large battlefield, the major peak forces certainly valued it highly.

Among these tens of thousands of Eleventh Levels, those reaching the fifth tier likely number hundreds to thousands, each equipped with a supreme weapon ‘lent’ from their respective peak race behind them.
